final_claims.bar_reason: no rival is likely to want Maatsen ()

chief.final_note: One claim this week: Murillo for Maatsen. He plays every minute, clears the defensive-contribution bar about half the time, and is a set-piece threat (second on Forest's direct free kicks; 1.25 xG this season). Holding everything else: Khalaili for his attacking upside under Palace's new manager, Estêvão while João Pedro is out, and Hinshelwood for his ceiling. Next week: drop Estêvão once João Pedro is back, and see whether Hinshelwood starts league games.
